title: Ministry of Social and Family Development
what_it_is: Ministry of Social and Family Development

sections.label: MSF focus areas
sections.summary: MSF will focus on strengthening marriages and families, providing a good start for the young, helping the vulnerable, and fostering a caring community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: MSF will focus on (a) strengthening marriages and families, (b) providing a good start for our young, (c) extending a helping hand for the vulnerable, and (d) fostering a caring community.

sections.label: ECDA childcare capacity expansion
sections.summary: ECDA will continue to expand childcare capacity, particularly in housing estates with more young children, with one place for every two children by 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) will continue to expand childcare capacity, particularly in housing estates with more young children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: There will be one childcare place for every two children by 2017.

sections.label: Social safety net strengthening
sections.summary: MSF will strengthen the social safety net, review legislations and policies, and improve services, having completed 24 SSOs and the first phase of SSNet.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We will continue to strengthen our social safety net, review legislations and policies and improve services to keep in step with emerging needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: We have completed the network of 24 Social Service Offices (SSOs) across Singapore, as well as the first phase of the Social Service Net (SSNet) – an integrated information sharing and case management system that will link MSF with other Government and VWO help agencies.

sections.label: Enabling Masterplan for disabilities
sections.summary: For persons with disabilities, the next Enabling Masterplan will be developed to build a more inclusive society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: For persons with disabilities, we will develop the next Enabling Masterplan to build a more inclusive society where they can lead more meaningful lives and become integral members of society.

sections.label: Grooming social service professionals
sections.summary: Through ECDA and SSI, a larger pool of committed and skilled social service professionals and leaders will be groomed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Through ECDA and the Social Service Institute (SSI), we will groom a larger pool of committed and skilled social service professionals and leaders.

sections.label: NCSS and Community Chest efforts
sections.summary: NCSS will work with VWOs to improve organisational capability and volunteer management, while the Community Chest extends its reach through new platforms and partnerships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The National Council of Social Service (NCSS) will work with VWOs to improve their organisational capability and management of volunteers so as to involve more Singaporean individuals and groups in enriching volunteering experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: The Community Chest will extend its reach by tapping on new platforms and partnerships to raise funds and rally public support to meet social needs.
